# Port of lib/pubid/api/parser.rb: API MPMS/typed/typeless identifiers
# with slash-combined second identifiers. The API MPMP normalization
# stays binder-side.
#
# Edition-2 notes: the combined form drops its first/second wrapper
# captures (a wrapper over rule refs expands to element hashes, and the
# bindings cannot nest); the second identifier's fields capture under
# second_* names so they never collapse onto the first's, mirroring the
# csa part_* / iec supp_* position-scoped conventions.

grammar PubidApi version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  num_letter_char = %x30-39 / %x41-5A
  doc_type = ("MPMS" / "BULL" / "SPEC" / "STD" / "RP" / "TR" / "COS" / "PUBL") as type
  second_doc_type = ("MPMS" / "BULL" / "SPEC" / "STD" / "RP" / "TR" / "COS" / "PUBL") as second_type
  chapter_notation = " CH " ( 1*digit ) as chapter
  year = ( 4digit ) as year
  second_year = ( 4digit ) as second_year
  date_dash = "-" year
  date_colon = ":" year
  second_date_dash = "-" second_year
  second_date_colon = ":" second_year
  reaffirmation = " (R" year ")"
  part_notation = ", Part " ( 1*digit ) as part_number
  second_part_notation = ", Part " ( 1*digit ) as second_part_number
  number_with_part = {
    (
      ( 1*(%x30-39 / %x41-5A) ) as number
      [ "-" ( 1*(%x30-39 / %x41-5A) ) as part ]
    )
  }
  second_number_with_part = {
    (
      ( 1*(%x30-39 / %x41-5A) ) as second_number
      [ "-" ( 1*(%x30-39 / %x41-5A) ) as second_part ]
    )
  }
  mpms_identifier = {
    "API " "MPMS" as type chapter_notation
    [ ( "." ( 1*digit [*upper] ) as section ) ]
    [ ( "." ( 1*digit [*upper] ) as subsection ) ]
    [(date_dash / date_colon)]
  }
  typed_identifier = {
    "API " doc_type " " number_with_part
    [part_notation]
    [(date_dash / date_colon)]
    [reaffirmation]
  }
  typeless_identifier = {
    "API " number_with_part
    [part_notation]
    [(date_dash / date_colon)]
    [reaffirmation]
  }
  second_identifier = {
    second_doc_type " " second_number_with_part
    [second_part_notation]
    [(second_date_dash / second_date_colon)]
  }
  edition_notation = ", " ( 1*digit ) as edition_number ("st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th") " edition"
  combined_identifier = {
    ( mpms_identifier / typed_identifier / typeless_identifier )
    "/"
    second_identifier
    [edition_notation]
  }
  identifier = combined_identifier / mpms_identifier / typed_identifier / typeless_identifier
  upper = %x41-5A
  digit = %x30-39
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  space = " "
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    type -> type (string)
    second_type -> second_type (string)
    chapter -> chapter (string)
    section -> section (string)
    subsection -> subsection (string)
    year -> year (string)
    second_year -> second_year (string)
    number -> number (string)
    part -> part (string)
    second_number -> second_number (string)
    second_part -> second_part (string)
    part_number -> part_number (string)
    second_part_number -> second_part_number (string)
    edition_number -> edition_number (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "API RP 1632-1987"
    accept "API MPMS CH 11.1"
    accept "API SPEC 5DP/STD 5DP, 1st edition"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
